h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Cuttack

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Cuttack

items.pText: Cuttack is one of Odisha's oldest cities, built on a strip of land between the Mahanadi and the Kathajodi rivers. Its neighbourhoods are dense, its parks are well used, and many of them have stood for decades. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Cuttack's schools, parks, residential complexes and clubs. We build it at our Vasai factory, about 1,360 km away, and install it with our team or a dealer in Odisha.

In older parks, the surface under the equipment is often the weakest part. Hard-packed soil, broken tiles or bare concrete are common, and none of them cushion a fall. Cuttack's heavy monsoon makes soil patches muddy and slippery for weeks. Adding rubber flooring under existing or new equipment is one of the most useful upgrades a park committee or school can make. We supply rubber flooring along with our play equipment.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Adding rubber flooring to an older play area

c: Rubber flooring needs a firm, level base. On a site with broken tiles or uneven soil, the base is prepared first, with a slight slope so rainwater runs off rather than pooling.

Cover the full safe play area of each piece, including the landing zone at the foot of every slide and the space in front of and behind swings. If you are replacing old equipment at the same time, plan the new layout first so the flooring matches it. A new

items.q: Can rubber flooring be laid in an existing park?
items.a: Yes, on a firm, level base. Broken tiles or uneven soil are prepared first, with a slope for drainage. We supply rubber flooring along with our playground equipment.

items.q: How much area should rubber flooring cover?
items.a: The full safe play area of each piece, including slide landing zones and the space in front of and behind swings. We mark these areas on the layout drawing.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Cuttack?
items.a: Yes. We make everything at our Vasai factory and send it to Cuttack by road. Our team or a dealer in Odisha installs it.
